program.intent: Convert timestamp and timezone offset into epoch microseconds and preserve exact formatting.
program.code:
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

def forward(groups):
    day, month, year, hour, minute, second, sp1, offset = groups
    text = f"{day.zfill(2)}/{month}/{year}:{hour}:{minute}:{second} {offset}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%d/%b/%Y:%H:%M:%S %z')
    epoch_micros = int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)
    return {'stored': [epoch_micros], 'layout': [len(sp1), len(day)]}

def inverse(record):
    epoch_micros = record['stored'][0]
    layout = record.get('layout', [])
    sp1_len = layout[0]
    day_width = layout[1]
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(epoch_micros / 1000000).astimezone()
    day = str(dt.day).zfill(day_width)
    month = dt.strftime('%b')
    year = dt.strftime('%Y')
    hour = dt.strftime('%H')
    minute = dt.strftime('%M')
    second = dt.strftime('%S')
    offset = dt.strftime('%z')
    return f"[{day}/{month}/{year}:{hour}:{minute}:{second}{' ' * sp1_len}{offset}]"
